## AGent Energy Raises $11 Million Series Seed Round
AGent Energy, an AI-driven distributed power plant developer in the behind-the-meter [renewable energy](https://igrownews.com/renewable-energy-news/) market, has closed an $11 million Series Seed financing round co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures.
The round brings the company’s total funding to $17 million within 12 months of its founding.

...

## Investors Back AGent Energy’s Growth
“Closing $17 million in our first year reflects both the urgency of the grid reliability challenge and the speed at which our team executes,” said [Stephanie Hendricks](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephanie-hendricks-85b56613/) , CEO and co-founder of AGent Energy.
